descriptionChirho: The proper name Belshazzar (Hebrew בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר), the last king of Babylon, son of Nabonidus, who appears in Daniel 5 and 7-8. The two sense clusters differ only by the prefixed preposition lamed ('of Belshazzar') versus the bare name, but both refer to the same historical person. Uniformly rendered across translations: English 'Belshazzar', Spanish 'Belsasar', Hindi बेलशस्सर, Arabic بَلْشَأصَّرُ, Korean 벨사살, Swahili 'Belshaza'. All 7 occurrences are confined to Daniel.
